name: Prestige Premium Loro Parque African Parrot Mix

variants.name: 1 kg
variants.about_this_item:
• Enriched seed mixture with extruded VAM pellets for African parrots
  • Enriched with vitamins, amino acids and minerals that help maintain vitality, strong immunity and a healthy plumage
  • Coarsely ground oyster shells as a source of highly absorbable calcium for strong bones and beak
  • Complete feed, balanced for daily use
variants.ingredient_information:
Composition: striped sunflower seeds, white sunflower seeds, safflower, VAM pellets, topped oats, maize, wheat, buckwheat, broken rice, milo, barley, peeled peanut, pumpkin seeds, oyster shells, dari, yellow millet, canary seed, pine nut, puffed wheat, carob, puffed maize, rosehip, chilli pepper.

Analytical constituents: protein 13.5%, fat content 16.5%, crude fibre 12.5%, crude ash 5%, calcium 0.94%, phosphorus 0.36%.

Nutritional additives per kg: vitamin A 8800 IU, vitamin D3 1600 IU, iron 19 mg, iodine 1.3 mg, copper 6.4 mg, manganese 48 mg, zinc 45 mg, selenium 0.2 mg.
variants.feeding_instructions: Balanced for daily use; extra supplements are generally not needed. For variety, up to 20% of the daily portion can be healthy snacks such as fruit and vegetables. Provide freely, change the feed regularly and always provide fresh drinking water. Avoid simultaneous oral use of macrolides.
